audience: teams that send documents for e-signing with Stiply

useCases.title: See which documents still wait for a signature
useCases.text: List sign requests and filter by status, such as published or rejected. Open one to read its message, dates and reject reason.

useCases.title: Check who has not signed yet
useCases.text: Open a sign request and list its signers with their role. Read the progress trail to see who opened the mail and who signed.

useCases.title: Find a sign request by the key of your own system
useCases.text: Look up a sign request with the external key that your system stored. Then list the documents attached to it.

useCases.title: Remind the signers of an open request
useCases.text: Find the open sign request. Send a reminder by email to the signers who have not signed. Extend the term if the date is close.

useCases.title: Send a new document for signature
useCases.text: Create a sign request from PDF links and send it to the signers. Confirm the signers first, because Stiply emails them at once.
